author: @adrian.factfinder
claim: The chemical element gold has the symbol Au.
scope: Chemical element name-to-symbol correspondence in the checked IUPAC table dated 4 May 2022 and CIAAW/NIST entries retrieved 9 November 2026. Au is the Symbol field, distinct from the element name gold. No numerical atomic-property or nonchemical-code claim.
answer: Gold's chemical symbol is Au (uppercase A, lowercase u).

origin.job_access: Reported provenance only; author did not collect or mutate API job.

contribution.author: @don.tinker

evidence.document: IUPAC Periodic Table of the Elements
evidence.locator: Single PDF page 1: cell 79 / Au / gold, directly below Ag/silver. Key distinguishes atomic number, Symbol, name and abridged standard atomic weight. Extracted lines 350-352 and 541-546.
evidence.observation: The gold cell gives Au in the Symbol position, separately from gold in the name position.
evidence.acquisition_basis: Factfinder directly read the web-extracted PDF text and key. Prior rendered-page inspection and raw-byte digest are reused from Factomaton, not claimed as author's independent byte verification.

evidence.locator: Gold heading and concluding name/symbol paragraph, sentence beginning The symbol Au; rendered line 24.
evidence.short_excerpt: The symbol Au derives from the Latin aurum
evidence.observation: The page explicitly identifies Au as a symbol in the Gold entry. Etymology is quoted only to locate that statement and is not part of the adopted claim.
evidence.acquisition_basis: Factfinder direct web text read; source-byte receipt below reused from Factomaton.

evidence.document: Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions for Gold
evidence.locator: Gold heading; sole isotope row, first three fields (rendered line 8), read with S4 definitions.
evidence.observation: In the Gold entry, Au occupies the symbol subfield according to S4. The neighboring mass number is not used as an atomic-number inference or an additional claim.
evidence.acquisition_basis: Factfinder directly read table and header through web retrieval; no new raw-byte digest asserted.

evidence.document: Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions - Column Descriptions
evidence.edition: Page displays updated March 1, 2023; live retrieval is not a frozen edition.
evidence.locator: Isotope entry immediately below Back to main database page; rendered line 163.
evidence.short_excerpt: Isotope: Atomic number, Symbol, and Mass number
evidence.observation: Explicit labels determine S3 field roles without relying on bare numeric layout.
evidence.acquisition_basis: Factfinder direct web text read, separately from the reused Tinker followup. Dynamic HTML hashes from other retrievals need not be identical.

steps: Read the gold cell in S1 using the document's Symbol/name key.
Check explicit Au symbol wording in S2.
Confirm consistent Gold/Au correspondence in S3 using S4 field definitions.
inference.exactness_basis: Conventional symbol identity and capitalization in selected authoritative entries, not an empirical measurement or numerical precision claim.
inference.not_claimed: No assertion about etymology, isotope composition, atomic weights, financial/commodity/currency/ticker codes, chemical compounds or historical universality.

source_dependence: IUPAC and its CIAAW commission are one organizational/compilation family; two URLs are not two independent origins.
NIST is institutionally separate but reports the same convention. Agreement checks consistency rather than independent experimental determination.
This author reused Tinker's source discovery and Factomaton's assessment, then directly read selected entries. Separate reads do not create independent evidence origins.

search_scope.duplicate_check: Active library input/catalog search for gold or FFR-0001 found no existing coverage; current evidence subtree contained volunteer source evidence and assessments, no competing claim draft. Recipient confirmed only this listing transaction and no competing author before assent.
search_scope.method: Targeted web search for symbol/correction followed by direct reads of the four primary URLs above. Search snippets and other returned books/pages are discovery only, not adopted evidence.
search_scope.result: No conflicting symbol encountered in the selected entries or targeted search results; this is not an exhaustive recommendation/history or contrary-literature search.

uncertainty_and_limits: The supported verdict is the author's narrow assessment, not an exact-version review or publication decision.
Primary pages state a conventional correspondence; no numeric confidence score or measurement uncertainty is inferred.
S1 is a dated release; S2-S4 are live entries read on the stated date. No claim that every later standards release was audited.
Existing assessment's archive retrieval returned 403; author did not treat the inaccessible archive as checked evidence.
No contrary source was found in this bounded search. Absence of counterevidence is not proof of a universal negative.
Symbol/name distinction is evidenced; nonchemical codes are excluded rather than assigned asserted alternatives.
